# Burrow

> One memory on a Mac that every AI model the person uses shares: their notes, documents and linked code, and a
> Ledger of the decisions made with their models and why, reached by any program as an MCP server (`burrow mcp <vault>`).
> macOS on Apple silicon; it calls no cloud model.

## For agents

- [Burrow for AI agents](https://satasdin.github.io/Burrow/agents.html): install Burrow for a person, connect over MCP, the tools, how to behave
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Satasdin/Burrow/blob/burrow/skills/AGENTS.md): the seven skills on one page, for an instructions file
- [Skills](https://satasdin.github.io/Burrow/skills.html): what each skill is for, and how to install them
- [BURROW.md](https://github.com/Satasdin/Burrow/blob/burrow/BURROW.md): every MCP tool, terminal command and app page in one file
